csi_precursor_theory.principle: When an elephant (dielectric body > 3,500 kg, high water content) enters the first Fresnel zone between the AP and ESP32 receiver, multipath propagation induces severe phase distortion and subcarrier amplitude attenuation. This provides precursor warning before physical line-of-sight sensors trigger.
